purpose: WAVE-3 CENSUS DESIGN CONSTRAINT. Two instruments, two OPPOSITE blind spots, and between them a real file can be invisible to both.

blind_spot_A.instrument: anything reading the FILESYSTEM -- directory listings, file counts, schema batteries, token predicates, reachability sweeps
blind_spot_A.evidence: 19 untracked .py estate-wide, none gitignored. A certifier's card battery certified 7 cards existing on one device.

blind_spot_B.instrument: the dependency graph's CALLS edges (extract_pipeline_cloud.py enrichment)
blind_spot_B.evidence: its own header, verbatim: 'A COMMITTED-BUT-NEVER-DEPLOYED script is invisible to enrichment BY DESIGN.' It parses DEPLOYED BYTES, not repo source.

\u26d4_THE_PAIR_IS_THE_FINDING: The two blind spots run in OPPOSITE directions. A file that is UNTRACKED BUT DEPLOYED is visible to the graph and invisible to git. A file that is COMMITTED BUT NOT DEPLOYED is visible to git and invisible to the graph. NEITHER INSTRUMENT ALONE SPANS THE POPULATION, and each returns a CLEAN, WELL-FORMED, CORRECTLY-CONTROLLED answer about its own domain while missing the other half.
why_it_bites_precisely_here: Both untracked candidates are the files a deployed-bytes view is most likely blind to. A CLEAN EMPTY RESULT from the graph on those two would be an artifact of the INSTRUMENT'S DOMAIN, not a statement about delegation -- 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X's point, and it is the reason a null there must not be read as a negative.
the_caveat_that_survives: UNTRACKED IS NOT UNDEPLOYED. storage_producer.py's own docstring describes an ancestor that RAN and emitted to S3 while never being committed -- precedent for the exact opposite case. So the two sets overlap in an unmeasured way.
wave_3_consequence: A materializer census must declare WHICH PLANE it read -- repo, deployed, or both -- and carry the other plane's blind spot as a stated limit. This is the same shape as the two-plane trigger census (events vs scheduler): a one-plane sweep returns a TRUE, correctly-controlled answer about the WRONG POPULATION.
NOT_a_gate: observation and a design constraint. No remediation authorized, no seat named at fault.
